_notes: Command templates are STARTING POINTS. S-009 must verify each one with `node scripts/orch.mjs probe` and correct it here.
Placeholders: {model} {packet} {worktree} {thinking}. The runner cd's into the worktree and passes the packet file contents as the prompt.
OpenCode models are addressed as opencode/<id>. Free Zen ids rotate; probe at the start of every phase.
Strength notes are priors from third-party reports, not guarantees. The live scorecard in orchestration/state.json overrides them.

gemini-low.note: Fast, cheap Gemini. Good for small edits, read-only exploration, summaries.

gemini-med.note: Default Gemini for review, audits and mid-complexity code.

gemini-high.note: Reserve for hard cross-cutting work, escalations and phase-gate reviews.

beam.note: Reported as the strongest free agentic coder. First choice for real implementation.

deepseek.note: Solid general coder with large context. Tests, backend Python, refactors.

glm.note: Cheap and quick. Mechanical edits, CSS and token work, boilerplate.

mimo.note: Fast. Reported tool-call fragility (several calls batched in one block). Use for read-only or single-shot tasks, not long tool loops.

nemotron-vl.note: Multimodal. Screenshot review and visual checks.

_t3_routing._note: DEC-001 2026-11-07: gemini CLI returns IneligibleTierError; opencode CLI has no run subcommand. All sub-agents dispatched via T3 delegate_task MCP tool instead of CLI exec. Mapping below.

nemotron-vl.note: NOT in current opencode list; use gemini-med or gemini-high for vision fallback

T1.name: Mechanical edits (renames, tokens, CSS, config, boilerplate)

T2.name: Component or page implementation with unit tests

T3.name: Complex or cross-cutting logic (theme engine, cross-filter, URL state, virtualization, motion, chart adapter)

T5.name: Fix loop from failing tests, types or lint

T6.name: Independent spec and Gherkin audit (must differ from the implementer)

T8.name: Backend Python (seed script, API additions, pytest)

escalation.note: A class chain is also the escalation path: move to the next entry on infra failure, or after max_fix_attempts_same_model quality failures.
